tags.feature: - Play 7 new levels! Aster has found never-seen-before stars in the sky.
- See the epilogue of Aster and Dad's story. There is even a new friend at the end.
- A brand new, Chill Corner-themed level is available to play.

- There's so many songs in Chill Corner, and with this collaboration, some of them is available in Ursid! There's so many songs that we actually had to build a new music player. Listen to unique songs each season.
- Since this is a collaboration, Chill Corner also has Ursid-themed content, too. You can set your avatar as Aster, and Aster's room is available.
- Since there are new levels, new achievements are added to the game. Now you can 100% the achievements!
- There's a new language option: Japanese!
- We know that some of our music has Content ID on Youtube, so now there's an option to only play streamer-friendly music.

notes.title: Epilogue update news, new English translation and demo available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[h2]Epilogue Progress[/h2]
It's been awhile since our last update. Since most of the bugs are squashed now (if you know any other bugs, please let us know), we've been working on the Epilogue update. It's coming nicely, and here's a sneak peak: [spoiler]We're going to include 7 brand-new levels for the epilogue[/spoiler]. Hope everyone's excited!

On another note...
[h2]New English Translation[/h2]
Our team don't speak English natively, so errors are bound to happen. Thanks to the help of our friend, MercTrans, we got the English's text proofread, so the English's translation should be much better now.

Last, but not least
[h2]We now have a demo[/h2]
The demo was actually released last week, but only now did we have time to announce it! And as a bonus, the demo is also updated with the new English translation, too.

Thank you for supporting us. And if you're still on the fence, give Ursid's demo a try! (it's free, of course).

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Fixed audio volume bug and more
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Update is 1.0.2 is now live! Here's what changed:
[list]
[*] Audio volume is not changeable in level is fixed.
[*] Fixed portrait in various dialogues.
[*] Fixed a bug when selecting full screen, the resolution is not applied correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug when player can still interact on the level selector when they are not supposed to.
[*] Fixed English localization.
[/list]
Thanks everyone for reporting the bugs!
